_readme: Settings for the relay (see Relay/README.md). Provider and company names live only here and in wrangler secrets, never in text the game shows. A provider serves calls only when its secret is set and its models list is not empty. Models and endpoints were checked against each provider's own docs on 2026-11-14 (see Relay/README.md); T16 may change the picks. Limits can be overridden per deploy or in wrangler dev with the vars SESSION_CALLS, IP_DAILY_CALLS, DAILY_CALLS and DAILY_TOKENS (DAILY_TOKENS applies to every provider). Each provider's "force" fields are set on every request (the cheapest effort that provider accepts), so calls through our keys never run at a higher effort.

limits._readme: A show is about 55 calls of 1,300 to 5,400 input tokens each (Findings in Docs/tasks/T07.md and T08.md). The day is the UTC day. session_calls is per session id per day, ip_daily_calls per player address per day, daily_calls for everyone together. ip_daily_events is analytics events (POST /event) per player address per day, counted apart from calls, with "test" events counted apart from real ones; override it with the var IP_DAILY_EVENTS.

free._readme: Free mode ("free": true) counts calls apart from real calls, so tests never use up the real budget. No tokens are counted.

events._readme: Analytics events (POST /event, see Relay/README.md). Each event lists the only fields it may carry; a field is optional, and an unknown event, an extra field, a wrong type, a number out of range or a string over its max length is a bad_request. Types: string (max = length), int (min, max), bool. Never add a field that holds typed text, keys or an address.
